answer: Use clocked location attestation. Each identity must pass timed challenges against independent beacon nodes, with measured round-trip floors matching its claimed region and continuous timing history. A shared wharf sensor cross-checks local clock arrivals so a single operator cannot fake many locations without violating light-speed limits. Per identity the attacker must pay for a distinct endpoint with calibrated clock and continuous bandwidth, so the zenith of apparent coverage is capped by real endpoints operated simultaneously.
